blocks.text: Another Thai beauty queen lands a pageant title after Saffron Maya Snook claimed the 2026 Miss Global crown on Sunday night, Oct. 11, or just a night after her compatriot Atsawahirankarn clinched the 2026 Miss Asia Pacific International title in Cebu. Snook was crowned Miss Global at the final competition held in Bangkok, Thailand, In both competitions, the Philippines’ representatives finished third runner-up. Filipino bet Jayvee Lyn Lorejo finished third runner-up at the Bangok tilt, while Gabrielle Galapia also got the same placement at the competition held in Cebu.
